description: This Java source file defines the class AmqpAdapterProperties, which extends ProtocolAdapterProperties and provides configuration properties specifically for an AMQP protocol adapter. It includes default values and getter/setter methods for frame size, session frames, session window size, and idle timeout, with validations in setters.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties class for the AMQP protocol adapter, including settings for frame size, session frames, session window size, and idle timeout.

methods.name: getMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum frame size in bytes for AMQP message delivery.

methods.name: setMaxFrameSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum frame size in bytes, validating that it is at least 512 bytes.

methods.name: getMaxSessionFrames
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of transfer frames per session.

methods.name: setMaxSessionFrames
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of transfer frames per session, ensuring it is at least 1.

methods.name: getMaxSessionWindowSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum session window size as product of maxFrameSize and maxSessionFrames.

methods.name: setIdleTimeout
methods.description: Sets the idle timeout in milliseconds, ensuring it is not negative.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured idle timeout in milliseconds.
